# Polkadot Pediatric Dentistry

> > Award-winning pediatric dental practice in Alpharetta and Johns Creek, Georgia led by board-certified Dr. Nanna Ariaban, specializing in comprehensive children's dental care from preventive treatments to emergency services.

Polkadot Pediatric Dentistry is a premier kids' dental practice serving the Alpharetta, Johns Creek, and Roswell areas of Georgia. Dr. Nanna Ariaban and her team provide comprehensive pediatric dental services with a focus on creating positive dental experiences for children and supporting their oral health development.
